cli.connections.notes.googleAi.descripti: Speech synthesis using the Google AI Gemini API.
cli.connections.notes.googleAi.billing: Usage-based pricing for input and output tokens. Paid generation runs only after an estimate and explicit approval.
cli.connections.notes.googleAi.quota: Check usage in Google AI Studio.
cli.connections.notes.groq.description: Groq fast inference API. Provides Whisper hosting (STT) at high speed and low cost. Direct uploads are limited to 25 MB, so long recordings need client-side chunks.
cli.connections.notes.groq.billing: Usage-based pricing (whisper-large-v3-turbo about $0.04/hour, minimum 10 seconds per request).
cli.connections.notes.groq.quota: Check usage and rate limits at console.groq.com. The doctor does not query them.
cli.connections.notes.elevenlabs.descrip: ElevenLabs speech synthesis API. Used for narration generation in stage 42.
cli.connections.notes.elevenlabs.billing: Plan pricing based on characters or credits. Paid generation requires prior approval.
cli.connections.notes.elevenlabs.quota: Subscription character and credit limits. The doctor checks authentication with a read-only request.
cli.connections.notes.elevenlabs.scopes: View user subscription / Generate speech after approval
cli.connections.notes.voicevox.descripti: VOICEVOX local engine for Japanese character voices. Fully local, free, and no API key needed. Used for draft narration and preset voices in stage 42.
cli.connections.notes.voicevox.quota: None (no rate limit for local execution).
cli.connections.notes.voicevox.scopes: Speech synthesis (the doctor only checks the local connection with a read-only request)
cli.connections.notes.openrouter.descrip: OpenRouter connection for choosing generative AI models from multiple providers through one API. Used in stages 00 and 42.
cli.connections.notes.openrouter.workflo: 00 Planning and research / 42 AI generated assets
cli.connections.notes.openrouter.billing: Usage-based pricing per selected model. Respect both per-key limits and the project budget.
cli.connections.notes.openrouter.quota: Key limit and limit_remaining. The doctor only checks authentication with a read-only request.
cli.connections.notes.openrouter.scopes: View key information / Call models after approval
